prompts.greeting: Namaste Didi! ASHA-Vani mein aapka swagat hai. Aap kis gaon mein hain aur kis marij ke ghar se bol rahi hain?
prompts.greeting_known_worker: Namaste {short_name} Didi ({asha_id})! ASHA-Vani mein aapka swagat hai. Marij (patient) ka poora naam aur gaon batayein.
prompts.greet_worker_ask_patient: Ji {short_name} Didi ({asha_id}), marij (patient) ka poora naam aur gaon batayein.
prompts.ask_asha_id: Kripya apna 3-digit ASHA worker ID batayein.
prompts.ASK_PATIENT_NAME: Didi, marij (patient) ka poora naam aur gaon batayein.
prompts.ASK_SPOUSE_NAME: Ji Didi, pati (husband) ka naam kya hai?
prompts.ASK_WEEKS: Theek hai. Unke pregnancy ke kitne hafte (weeks) hue hain? Agar garbhvati nahi hain toh zero batayein.
prompts.ASK_BP: Ji, unka BP (blood pressure) kitna aaya hai? Systolic aur diastolic dono number batayein.
prompts.ASK_BP_NON_PREGNANT: Ji Didi, Non-Pregnant checkup note ho gaya. Unka BP (blood pressure) kitna aaya hai? Systolic aur diastolic dono number batayein.
prompts.ASK_HB: Unka Hemoglobin (Hb) kitna aaya hai, aur koi takleef ya lakshan hai kya?
prompts.ASK_SYMPTOMS: Kya unhe pet mein dard, tez sar dard, dhundhla dikhna, bleeding, daura, soojan, paani aana, ya bachche ki halchal kam lagna hai?
prompts.confirm_routine: Dhanyavaad Didi. {label} ka record confirm ho gaya hai. Kya aap kisi aur mahila ka record dena chahti hain?
prompts.confirm_escalate: Dhanyavaad Didi. {label} ka record confirm ho gaya hai. Screening {level} hai, kripya PHC team se turant sampark karein. Kya aap kisi aur mahila ka record dena chahti hain?
prompts.next_patient: Theek hai Didi. Ab agle marij ka poora naam aur gaon batayein.
prompts.finish_call: Dhanyavaad Didi. ASHA-Vani call ab band ho rahi hai. Namaste.
prompts.continue_prompt: Didi, kya aap kisi aur garbhavati mahila ka record dena chahti hain? Haan ya nahi batayein.
prompts.history_match: Mujhe {village} ki {name} ka purana record mila hai. Kya yeh wahi patient hain? Haan ya nahi batayein.
prompts.history_yes: Theek hai. Kya aap unka pichhla visit summary sunna chahti hain? Haan ya nahi batayein.
prompts.history_another: Theek hai. Ek aur purana record mila: {name}, gaon {village}, pati/guardian {spouse}. Kya yeh wahi patient hain?
prompts.history_no_more: Theek hai, main ise alag patient ke roop mein darj karungi.
prompts.read_history: Pichhle visit mein {name} ke liye {details} darj tha. Yeh sirf purana record hai. {prompt}
prompts.read_history_default_prompt: Ab naye visit ki jaankari confirm karein.
prompts.history_repeat: Didi, kya aap pichhla visit summary sunna chahti hain? Haan ya nahi batayein.
prompts.correct_generic: Theek hai Didi. Kaunsi jaankari galat hai? Sahi value dobara batayein.
prompts.correct_spouse: Theek hai Didi. Pati ka sahi naam batayein.
prompts.correct_patient: Theek hai Didi. Marij ka sahi naam batayein.
prompts.correct_bp: Theek hai Didi. Sahi BP ke dono number batayein.
prompts.correct_weeks: Theek hai Didi. Pregnancy ke sahi hafte batayein.
prompts.correct_hb: Theek hai Didi. Sahi Hemoglobin (Hb) batayein.
prompts.repeat_bp: Kripya BP ke dono number dobara batayein.
prompts.repeat_escalate_prefix: Screening {level} hai, kripya PHC team se jaldi sampark karein. {prompt}
prompts.collect_confirm_fallback: Kripya in jaankariyon ko confirm karein.
prompts.readback_empty: abhi koi visit detail record nahi hui
prompts.readback_changed: Theek hai, badal diya: {changed_summary}. Screening {level} hai. Kya yeh jaankari sahi hai?
prompts.readback: Didi, confirm karein: {summary}. Screening {level} hai. Kya yeh jaankari sahi hai?
prompts.language_switched: Theek hai Didi, ab main Hindi mein baat karungi.
prompts.language_menu: Bhasha badalne ke liye: Hindi ke liye 1, Tamil ke liye 2, Telugu ke liye 3 dabayein.
